_comment: Committed retrieval baseline. /eval compares against this. Update it deliberately, in the same PR as the change that moved it, with the reason in the commit message.
note: Post-expansion baseline over the full 48-paper literature review. recall@1 held at 0.35 but depth collapsed (recall@10 0.95 -> 0.75); reaching the old k=10 coverage now needs k=50. See docs/decisions/004. Only 10 questions, so treat as directional: R2 freezes a ~40-question set before any comparison.
